# API Types — Generated

**This directory is auto-generated from the FastAPI OpenAPI spec.
DO NOT EDIT directly.**

CI will fail if the OpenAPI spec changes without regeneration.
See `scripts/generate_types.py` for the exact regen command.

```
npm run generate:types
# or
npx tsx scripts/generate_types.py
```

This directory is tracked in version control with a minimal committed
placeholder (see `placeholder-spec.json`) so that the directory is never
empty. When the real FastAPI spec is available, run the regen command
to populate it with proper TypeScript types.

The generated types power the API client in `src/lib/apiClient.ts`.
